sloka: इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सान्त्वपूर्वमिवार्थवत् ।अभ्यकीर्यत शोकेन भूय एव महीपतिः ॥२-१४-५८॥
transliteration: iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sāntvapūrvamivārthavat ।abhyakīryata śokena bhūya eva mahīpatiḥ ॥2-14-58॥

translations.english: Hearing these meaningful words of Sumantra uttered in an appealing tone, the lord of the earth relapsed into grief.
